predecessors.name: Somaliland
predecessors.text: Las Anod, Sool and the Dhulbahante lands round it ('parts of the Sool, Sanaag and Togdheer regions'), from the Somaliland front at about 100 km west of Las Anod to the Somaliland border; the same 120…

ledger.x: 6 February 2023: the Dhulbahante elders announce SSC-Khatumo in Las Anod.
25 August 2023: SSC-Khatumo takes the eastern Sool.
28 August 2023: SSC-Khatumo declares a cessation of hostilities, 'citing a strategic withdrawal of forces from Las Anod'.
30 July 2025: Khatumo is reconstituted as the North Eastern State of Somalia.

wars.name: 2023 Las Anod conflict
wars.outcome: 6 February to 28 August 2023: SSC-Khatumo captured the Maraaga and Goojacade bases and the towns of Las Anod district and Sool; the Somaliland army withdrew about 100 km west of Las Anod; the Federal Government of Somalia recognised SSC-Khatumo on 19 October…

certainty.note: A military front between Oog and Guumays, a stalemate since the autumn of 2023; no treaty or survey line, so the edge is soft.
